items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Jose Miguel Gomez was the president

ctx.x: Okay. All right, politically, What do you remember about that time period when you were about ten years old?
Well, at that time I think that Jose Miguel Gomez was the president and then after that was Zayas and then after that was Menocal.
Okay - Jose Miguel Gomez, What do you remember about him at all?
